description: An Employee Relations Partner must decide whether Avery may serve as a peer interviewer for an internal transfer candidate and finalize the panel structure, interview safeguards, and documentation.

shared_context.S1: Avery has been proposed as a peer interviewer for Jordan's internal transfer to the customer-success team.
shared_context.S2: Rina makes the final decision about Avery's participation and the interview safeguards.
shared_context.S3: Leah is available to serve as an alternate peer interviewer if Rina does not approve Avery.
shared_context.S4: The interview is expected to include a hiring manager and a peer interviewer.
shared_context.S5: Before confirming the panel, Rina follows the standard check-in with the proposed interviewer, the hiring manager, and HR Operations.
shared_context.S6: As part of this check-in, anyone with firsthand observations about a proposed panelist's suitability must use the formal disclosure action to put those observations on the record, rather than only describing a general concern in a discussion.

PF1.text: Avery directly observed three separate occasions during the last project when Avery made dismissive comments about Jordan's work in group meetings; Avery has not included these observations in the transfer-panel materials because no one requested an interpersonal-risk review.

PF2.text: Jordan told Devon in a private transfer discussion that Jordan will participate in the process only if there is no one-to-one interview with Avery and the questions are provided in writing beforehand; Devon has not relayed this because the panel discussion was not yet scheduled.

PF3.text: Marta confirmed this week that an internal-transfer panel must have exactly two interviewers, must record any prior supervisory or interpersonal conflict involving a panelist, and must use a replacement panelist when that conflict makes the proposed pairing unsuitable; this confirmation has not yet been added to the panel checklist.

acceptance_conditions: Avery must not serve as the peer interviewer.
Leah must be appointed as the peer interviewer.
The panel must contain exactly two interviewers.
Interview questions must be provided in writing beforehand.
Jordan must not have a one-to-one interview with Avery.
The prior interpersonal conflict must be recorded in the panel materials.
Exactly three observed incidents must be documented.
A commitment to confirm the safeguards with Jordan must be logged.

content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'process_safeguard' and c['target'] == 'Jordan' and 'confirm' in c['detail'] and 'safeguard' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Avery's three firsthand observations change the assignment from approving Avery to selecting Leah, change the conflict record from absent to required, and set the documented observation count to exactly 3.

Jordan's stated condition changes the interview format to written questions, prohibits a one-to-one interview with Avery, and requires a process-safeguard commitment to confirm those safeguards with Jordan.
The confirmed panel rule changes the structure to exactly 2 interviewers and requires the prior conflict to be recorded when the proposed pairing is unsuitable.
